i.norm: Verifies that an ObjectGraphIterator constructed from a plain root object (not an Iterator) with a null transformer can itself be passed as the root of a second ObjectGraphIterator, also with a null transformer. A null transformer means each element is returned as-is without transformation.
Build an iterator over a single Integer root; null transformer means no-op transform
Since ObjectGraphIterator implements Iterator, it can itself be used as the root of another ObjectGraphIterator, enabling nested iteration of iterators
